assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: wide decorative illustration for the connection/setup page of OrderHub, a professional Windows desktop order management application. This is a reusable background image asset, NOT a screenshot or mockup.
Primary request: create a beautiful, restrained premium editorial 3D still life that suggests an orderly central hub connecting a small set of precise modular channels. A sculptural brushed graphite ring and three neatly interlocking rails, a small number of frosted translucent glass inserts. Abstract architecture of connection and coordination, not a logo.
Scene/backdrop: deep charcoal studio background, softly illuminated; open negative space surrounding the central composition so the application can place actual controls in a separate adjacent panel. Wide landscape composition, approximately 3:2, all objects comfortably within safe margins.
Style/medium: sophisticated industrial design render, crisp physically plausible edges, satin aluminium, smoked glass, subtle pale cool highlights, one restrained muted teal accent. Controlled studio lighting, delicate contact shadows, calm and credible, visually quiet enough for a financial workstation.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, watermark, graphs, candlesticks, currency symbols, decorative UI panels, screenshots, status checkmarks, locks or claims of security. No flashy neon, no magenta, no stock-market bull, no giant glowing orbs. Deliver one finished raster image, not a collage.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable square transparent illustration for the software update panel in OrderHub, a professional Windows desktop order management application.
Primary request: a refined miniature industrial product sculpture suggesting a new software package ready for review: a precise open graphite docking tray with one floating frosted-glass rectangular module above it and two thin neatly aligned satin aluminium layers below. A tiny muted teal inset is part of the material, not a status light. Rich high-quality modelling with rounded machined edges, restrained details and believable occlusion.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no solid background, no checkerboard baked in, no floor plane. Only the isolated object and a very subtle local contact shadow.
Style/medium: premium editorial 3D illustration, brushed graphite, satin aluminium, smoke-grey frosted glass, subtle muted teal detail. Calm professional industrial design, soft studio light and crisp readable silhouette.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered three-quarter isometric view, all parts visible, subject fills around 65 percent of canvas, at least 15 percent transparent safety margin around the silhouette. Readable at 240 CSS pixels, enough material detail for larger display. Works over light or dark app surfaces.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, watermark, arrows, progress bars, checkmarks, shields, locks, success badges, currency symbols, screenshot or interface. Must not imply that download or installation has succeeded. One cohesive object, not multiple alternative tiles.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable square transparent illustration for an unavailable/not-yet-connected query module in OrderHub, a professional desktop order management application.
Primary request: a beautiful quiet editorial 3D miniature of an orderly graphite archive cradle holding three plain frosted-glass dividers and one unmarked satin aluminium data tile resting gently in front. The scene conveys space reserved for future information, with a calm neutral mood. It is not a literal file icon and contains no printed information.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no solid color, no baked checkerboard, no background card or floor plane. A subtle local contact shadow is acceptable.
Style/medium: the same premium industrial material family: brushed graphite, satin aluminium, smoke-grey frosted glass and a very small muted teal insert. Soft controlled studio lighting, tactile precision, rounded machined edges, refined not playful.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered three-quarter isometric view, entire subject visible and around 65 percent of canvas, at least 15 percent transparent safety margin. Strong elegant silhouette readable at 220 CSS pixels, usable on a dark or light UI.
Constraints: no text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, empty-result wording, magnifying glass icon, checkmarks, error symbols, people, charts or screenshots. Do not imply a query ran successfully or that there are zero orders. One cohesive illustration only.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: reusable square transparent illustration for a connection-recovery information panel in OrderHub, a professional Windows desktop order management application.
Primary request: a sophisticated editorial 3D still life of two compact machined graphite connector modules facing each other across a small clean gap, with a single delicate segmented frosted-glass bridge between them that has not yet joined. The physical metaphor is a connection being re-established. Balanced, reassuringly calm and operational, no dramatic damage.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background with no solid backdrop, no baked checkerboard, no floor plane. Keep only the sculpture and a minimal local contact shadow.
Style/medium: premium industrial design render, brushed graphite, satin aluminium, smoke-grey frosted glass, one very restrained muted teal material accent, soft studio highlights, crisp edge definition, subtle occlusion. Match a refined financial desktop application's neutral visual language.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered three-quarter isometric composition, complete silhouette around 65 percent of canvas, at least 15 percent transparent safety margin. Readable at 220 CSS pixels on light and dark surfaces.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, Wi-Fi icon, progress ring, arrows, checkmark, warning triangle, red error lamp, charts, currency signs or UI screenshot. It must not imply connected or successfully recovered. One coherent illustration, not a sprite sheet.

edits.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: square transparent illustration for an OrderHub desktop connection-recovery panel.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target.
Change only the framing and the outer ends: fit the entire existing two connector modules AND their short cable/stub ends comfortably within the square canvas. Each outer end should terminate with a neat fully visible endcap, not continue off canvas. Scale the complete cluster down to occupy no more than 68 percent of the canvas width, with at least 16 percent genuinely transparent margin left and right. Preserve the separation between the connectors and the small floating frosted glass segments, the graphite/aluminium/glass materials, muted teal details, exact calm three-quarter view, and lighting. Preserve genuine transparency and leave no opaque background, no checkerboard pattern. Clean anti-aliased silhouette without white fringe. No text, symbols, watermark, status lights, warning signs or new objects. This must look disconnected/reconnecting, not connected or successfully recovered.
